component: Preferences new-tab completion and browser-test setup

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new-tab onLoad callback awaits selectPrefPane before resolving openPreferencesTab with the preferences Window. For a different requested category, selectPrefPane awaits gotoPref and its category initialization. Both shared test heads now await that public result and check Window identity. This is an explicit new-tab completion chain; the same-category early return, synchronous existing-tab selection and setTimeout-based section scrolling retain separate limits. The source and assertions do not establish a universal intermittent cure or completed scrolling.
title: A new preferences tab resolves after its explicit pane-selection promise
